dedupe_keys.name: swiss rhine ports transhipment statistics and monthly bulletins port of switzerland

description: Port of Switzerland (Schweizerische Rheinhäfen) publishes monthly transhipment figures as bulletins and annual statistics. The annual statistics cover Rhine port traffic by goods group and by port facility, container traffic, land transport links, the Swiss fleet and passenger shipping, and the bulletins give the monthly transhipment totals, with a key from the older NSTR goods classification to NST 2007. Coverage is the Swiss Rhine ports, so it is national for Swiss Rhine navigation. The bulletins and statistics are free to read and download as PDF files on the port's facts and figures page, with older statistics and annual reports in an archive, and a contact is named for questions; no licence is stated. Caveats: the figures are published as PDF documents, not machine-readable tables, and water levels at the Basel-Rheinhalle gauge, which drive capacity during low water, are published separately by the Federal Office for the Environment. The monthly volumes support analysis of inland waterway freight, low-water disruption on the Rhine and hinterland capacity planning. They complement the CCNR market observation reports and are related to the Destatis inland shipping statistics.
